body.name: Distinct-protocol cost \(\operatorname{Cost}\)
body.construction:
For \(F\in\{E_0,E,E_{\mathrm{sw}}\}\), let \(\operatorname{Prot}(F)\) contain each distinct acquired protocol mask occurring in \(F\), including an empty-ownership paid-protocol marker, exactly once.  Define
\[
 \operatorname{Cost}(F)=\sum_{S\in\operatorname{Prot}(F)}\sum_{a\in S}c(a).
\]
Slices, labelled sources, factors, and branches sharing one protocol incur no additional acquisition cost.
